welcome.text: Welcome to The Bay Compassion. This is a short guide to signing up and following your visit on your phone.

open.text: Scan the market’s code to open the market page on your phone. You can sign up from anywhere, even at home.

language.text: Choose your language. The app remembers it, and you can change it at the top of the screen anytime.

closed.text: If the market is closed, come back on Saturday at ten thirty in the morning.

window.text: Sign-up stays open for fifteen minutes. The timer shows how much time is left. There’s no need to rush. Signing up early doesn’t change your chances.

identity.text: Enter your first and last name, and your cell phone number. Please use your full name, rather than just initials.

household.text: Answer the questions about your household. Include yourself in the total, and tell us how many children and seniors you’re shopping for.

returning.text: If this phone already remembers you, your name and phone are saved. Check your household details for today’s visit.

join.text: When you’ve finished, tap Join the lottery.

registered.text: You’re in the lottery confirms that you entered. Your number comes after the draw, if you’re selected.

texts.text: Text updates are optional. To receive them, tap Text Me About Updates, then read and agree to the text message consent and tap Enable text updates.

draw.text: At ten forty-five, the lottery draws. This page updates on its own and shows your result. Everyone has the same chance, and not everyone gets a number.

notSelected.text: If it says Not selected today, you can enter again next Saturday at ten thirty. We’re sorry we couldn’t offer you a place today.

number.text: If you’re selected, you’ll see You’re on the list, and your number. Maya’s number is four. Head to the market with the phone you signed up on.

line.text: Keep this page open to follow the line. Your number stays at the top. Now calling underneath shows the numbers being called at the check-in desk.

display.text: The room display shows the same numbers. Watch your phone for your own turn, even as the display moves on.

called.text: Shopping begins at eleven thirty. When you’re called, your phone says It’s your turn, and your number turns green.

checkin.text: Come to the check-in desk now. Show your number on the phone you signed up on. We can’t accept screenshots.

late.text: If you’re taking a little longer, your number gradually turns yellow. Please come to the check-in desk. The color is a reminder that others are waiting.

missed.text: If your screen says We missed you, and you’re still here, speak with a market team member at the check-in desk.

finished.text: After check-in, your phone says Thank you for coming. Your visit is complete.

missedWindow.text: If you missed sign-up, the page explains that registration has closed. Come back next Saturday at ten thirty.

underway.text: If the market is already underway, registration has closed for the day. It opens again next Saturday at ten thirty, and everyone who signs up has the same chance.

help.text: Need a reminder? Tap How it works anytime. Thank you for being here.
